submittedParameters.prompt: EDIT IMAGE 1, precise controlled pose edit of one transparent southeast-running game character. Image1 is the approved previous frame14. Preserve its leg identity and SCREEN SIDES exactly: the LARGE AIRBORNE boot is on the LEFT side of the image and belongs to his ANATOMICAL RIGHT leg. The SMALL GROUNDED boot is on the RIGHT side of the image underneath the SHIELD and belongs to his ANATOMICAL LEFT leg. DO NOT SWAP THESE SCREEN SIDES. Keep the small grounded left boot to the RIGHT of the large lifted right boot. The small screen-right boot stays flat/forefoot on ground with its toe aimed diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, no broad outsole visible. The large screen-left airborne boot remains lifted and aimed along same travel direction; sole may face viewer. Keep both hip-to-knee-to-ankle connections as image1. This is a continuation of SAME LEFT-FOOT support, no support change until the next cycle. Input2 identity details, input3 southeast idle direction, input4 approved rendering style, input5 preceding frame13 for exact support foot identity. Keep framing and proportions of image1, same hair, clothing, beads, shield in anatomical LEFT hand SCREEN RIGHT, staff in anatomical RIGHT hand SCREEN LEFT. Both natural hands and intact full weapons. No whole-body translation, mirroring, extra limbs, labels, effects, ground or shadows. Real transparent alpha. Target frame16: Next unique late-push pose: small SCREEN-RIGHT support boot remains planted in same right-side rear contact zone with just slightly raised heel; large SCREEN-LEFT swing leg lowers a little farther, knee slightly straighter and lifted boot poised before next landing. Keep a clear gap between soles and never put small grounded boot left of the large one. Shoulder tilts forward a little, staff wrist turns slightly, a different natural trailing cloth fold. Only one full-body sprite.
